author: Heavy_Vermicelli_263
body:
At some stage, the game becomes all about getting the incremental benefits.

\- Any gear below ornate is worthless

\- then any gear below 190 ornate is worthless

\- then any gear below 200 ornate is worthless

These tiny quality boni all add up to increasing those chances. It also gets you close to the huge bonus for reaching 100 total levels across all anguish categories
